  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ (PMID 30392755, Table X).",

  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma and in the same operative setting whenever possible (PMID 30392755, Table X).",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis (PMID 39709737, Recommendation 1).",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia (PMID 39709737, Recommendation 1).",
  "The consensus rate for the recommendation is 100 % (21 out of 21 participants) (PMID 39709737).",

  "The management recommendation remains unchanged after the override; excision is still indicated."
